'''Carnor Jax Hunt Down the Jedi''' is a [[Dark]] constructed list published on [[Game Players Network]].

== Deck info ==
* '''Player:''' [[Carnor Jax]]
* '''Published:''' 9 October 2004 (Game Players Network)
* '''GPN category:''' Standard
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Original VS6]]
* '''Side:''' [[Dark]]
* '''Starting Card:''' {{CardLink|Hunt Down And Destroy The Jedi / Their Fire Has Gone Out Of The Universe|SE-D-huntdownanddestroythejedi.gif|label=Hunt Down And Destroy The Jedi}}
* '''Starting Interrupt:''' {{CardLink|Prepared Defenses|DS2-D-prepareddefenses.gif}}
* '''Strategy:''' Hunt Down And Destroy The Jedi
* '''GEMP Importable deck:''' [[Media:POVS6 HD Jax DS 2004 GPN.txt |Download]] (omits Bad Feeling Have I (V), Ability, Ability, Ability (V), Blaster Rack (V), IG-88 (V), IG-88's Neural Inhibitor (V): no GEMP blueprint)

== Introduction ==

Deck i've been working on for awhile. Trying to make it better.

The published list has 58 cards.

== Notes ==

* Qty 58 as published (no section counts are given).
* Posted Darth Maul, YA dested Darth Maul, Young Apprentice; EPP Boba Fett / EPP Vader / EPP 4-Lom dested Boba Fett With Blaster Rifle / Darth Vader With Lightsaber / 4-LOM With Concussion Rifle; Darth Vader's Lightsaber dested Vader's Lightsaber; 'Combat Rediness (Combat Response was mistake)' dested Combat Readiness.
* Original-era (V) cards: Blaster Rack (V) (Virtual Set 1); Bad Feeling Have I (V), IG-88 (V), IG-88's Neural Inhibitor (V) (Virtual Set 5); Ability, Ability, Ability (V) (Virtual Set 6).

== Strategy ==

Pull Vader and my Dueling Effects with Bad Feeling Have I(v). Duel Obi and Luke, then Deploy Emporer and Emporer's Power and Other characters to beat down on the characters.
